0022600127.text: The Golden State Warriors (0-3, 14th in the West, 4th in the Pacific and 3 games back) visit the Denver Nuggets (1-1, 7th in the West) for their fourth game of the season, looking for their first win after three straight losses. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Brandon Williams (back soreness), Charles Bassey (knee) and Gui Santos (knee tendinitis) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. Denver is missing Alpha Diallo (wrist), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision; the teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and Denver won the last meeting 116-93 in Denver on March 29, 2026, with no games yet in the 2026-27 series.
